title: A fully automated deep learning-based network for detecting COVID-19 from a new and large lung CT scan dataset.
summary: Full Methods and Results: COVID-CTset contains CT images from 95 COVID-19 patients and 282 normal persons; five-fold testing is described at image and patient-condition stages. A proposed ResNet feature-pyramid CNN and image-selection pipeline classify patient status; authors report correct classification for 234/245 in the patient-condition phase. This is a single-source dataset diagnostic feasibility result, not independent clinical validation.
